'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Erich Hawbaker DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Erich Hawbaker]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V)|V26-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Erich Haubaker(?)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
